legacy_16_accounting.desc: promote 不再拒绝 v1 证据
legacy_16_accounting.load_bearing_type: secondary_guard_rejection (trusted_context_missing exception mismatch, not promotion success)
legacy_16_accounting.note: Legacy test passes v1 evidence lacking trusted_context. When version check is ablated, execution fails at require_independent_slow_producer with trusted_context_missing. Pytest fails due to exception message mismatch, NOT because illegal promotion succeeded. True promotion success requires forging v1 with all v2 fields.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: v2 证据字段校验整体不执行
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating _validate_v2() allows invalid calibration dataclass to construct without ValueError, causing pytest.raises(ValueError) to fail.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: D/C/T 两两不相交检查被拆
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating disjoint check allows overlapping D/C/T in data_identity at construction, causing pytest.raises(ValueError) to fail.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: SLOW 守卫不再拦截类别 self (producer='student')
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating SLOW_FORBIDDEN_CATEGORIES check allows category 'self' to pass producer check, failing the rejection assertion.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: 不再要求 admission_bindings 存在 producer 绑定
legacy_16_accounting.load_bearing_type: exception_crash (AttributeError on NoneType.get, not promotion success)
legacy_16_accounting.note: In legacy test, deleting `if matched is None: raise ...` causes the next line `matched.get(...)` to raise AttributeError because matched is None. Pytest fails with AttributeError, NOT because bare producer succeeded. True promotion success requires returning category on matched is None.
Ablating binding digest verification allows tampered binding_sha256 to pass validation.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: 缺来源/对象/动作键的条目仍可晋升
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating promotion_gaps check allows fragment missing provenance to be promoted.
Ablating content_digest check allows evidence with mismatched entry_digest to promote.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: Fragment 标识符不再拦截世界真值 ID
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating world-truth check allows fragment with gt_/eval_ identifiers to construct.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: 版本漂移不再触发重验
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating version match check in usable_slow_items allows drifted entries to be used.
Ablating DEMOTABLE_LEVELS check allows demote(..., to_level='slow') to succeed.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: supersede 指针可被反复改写
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating single-shot supersede check allows overwriting existing supersede pointer.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: ParamBeliefStore 不再限定只由 PARAMETRIC 分支写
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating route_code check allows non-parametric route to write ParamBeliefStore.

legacy_16_accounting.desc: 4a/4b 路由记录不再要求 NIS 统计量与自由度
legacy_16_accounting.note: Ablating NIS stat check allows 4a/4b route records with None nis_stat/dof.
Ablating digest check allows tampered registration content to pass self-check.
Ablating require_slow_eligible_origin allows LLM/teacher origin to promote to SLOW.
